title: Find an email with search
summary: Search your mailbox by sender or subject and open what you find.

steps.say: Press Control and E to jump to the search box.

checks.prompt: Is the search box at the top of Outlook active, with a blinking cursor?

hints: You can also click the Search box at the top of the window.
steps.why: Search looks through every email faster than scrolling.

steps.say: Type a name or a few words from the subject, then press Enter.
hints: Write from: and a name to see only email from that person.
steps.why: Fewer, clearer words give better results.

steps.say: Double-click the email you want to open it.

check.prompt: Is an email open in its own window or in the reading pane?

hints: One click shows it in the reading pane on the right.
steps.why: Opening it shows the whole message and its attachments.

steps.say: Press Escape in the search box to see your whole Inbox again.
hints: The cross at the right end of the search box does the same.
steps.why: Search results stay until you clear them.
